faq.heading: What is The Huntress Cookbook?
faq.content: A website of gluten-free, onion-free, IBS-conscious recipes. Browse chapters, open a recipe, and read the notes. It is meant to be read in the browser.

faq.heading: Do I need an account?
faq.content: No. The chapters are open to read. There is nothing to sign in to.

faq.heading: What is in the cookbook?
faq.content: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, braai, soups and comfort foods, desserts, snacks and picnic foods, drinks, and approved Huntress meals, plus an introduction, a dietary guide, pantry essentials, and recipes still to try.

faq.heading: Can I print a recipe?
faq.content: Yes. Open the recipe and print the page, or save it as a PDF from the print dialog.

faq.heading: Is this the same as the phone app?
faq.content: No. The website and Huntress Cookbook Mobile are separate. Recipes you add on the phone stay on the phone. Reading the site does not change the app.
